name: icloud
mount_caveat: Mounts, but see hazards — this provider has caused the most trouble in practice.
offline_requirement: Turn OFF "Optimise Mac Storage" for this folder, or files get evicted and read as 0 bytes.
delete_note: No iCloud connector exists. Use `allow_cowork_file_delete`; there is no fallback.
hazards: Cloud-only files copy as 0 BYTES and fail silently. Always verify size > 0 after any copy.
The `zip` binary fails on its rename step. Build archives in scratch with Python's zipfile, then copy in.
No connector, so deletion has no fallback path if Cowork's permission prompt is declined.

SHARED MODE: eviction is per-machine. A co-user with 'Optimise Mac Storage' on reads curated files as 0 bytes; summarising that empty read and writing it back destroys the file for everyone. Run preflight.py before trusting any read.
sharing: iCloud folder sharing works for co-users: share the folder with 'Can make changes' and each person's Mac syncs a local copy Cowork can mount. No connector exists, but Cowork does not need one - it reads the local filesystem. The real requirement is that 'Optimise Mac Storage' is OFF for this folder ON BOTH MACHINES: it is a per-machine setting, so one co-user's choice can silently evict files the other relies on.
